messages:
devon: Heads-up, monitoring alerted: janitor heartbeat missing on a subset of eu-west2 nodes and we saw a metadata ledger compact overlap. attaching logs.
alex: Thanks. Any user-visible impact?
maria: Yes — GPU fleet provisioning is hitting attach failures in eu-west2, a few thousand pending. Some jobs queued for >5m.
ingrid: Logs show janitor restarted twice and the ledger compaction ran concurrently. suspect double-compact race caused stale-extent refs.
sam: Can you paste the compact logs snippet?
devon: sure — from node gn-eu-23:
```
2026-03-23T08:04:12Z janitor[pid=2421]: heartbeat missed (ttl=0)
2026-03-23T08:04:19Z janitor[pid=2421]: restart requested
2026-03-23T08:04:20Z compactor[pid=1500]: started compaction ledger=le-4332
2026-03-23T08:04:20Z compactor[pid=1501]: started compaction ledger=le-4332
2026-03-23T08:04:21Z compactor[pid=1501]: finished compaction delta=+0 - ambiguous refs
2026-03-23T08:04:22Z compactor[pid=1500]: finished compaction delta=+0 - completed
2026-03-23T08:04:23Z storage[pid=900]: extent-ref-check failed id=0x7f3a err=ENODATA
```
alex: Oof — two compactor processes for same ledger. That explains the ENODATA on extent refs.
maria: Impact path: extent-ref gone -> NVMe local index stale -> attachment controller fails validation -> GPU attach rejected. Also janitor cleanup removed tempfile markers.
ingrid: How many nodes affected?
devon: Initial sweep: 8 nodes in eu-west2, all on same janitor release v2.4.1. A few had extra restarts due to k8s liveness flaps (OOMKilled yesterday).
sam: Is this limited to eu-west2? any cross-region correlation?
devon: So far only eu-west2. Other regions run v2.4.0 or v2.4.2 canaries. Only hosts with the v2.4.1 binary + k8s 1.28 had the race.
alex: Immediate mitigation ideas?
maria: 1) Pause compaction via kill -SIGSTOP on compactor (fast but manual) 2) Fallback: route new gpu attach requests to other regions (routing config change) 3) Hotfix: disable concurrent compaction in config and roll restart fleet.
ingrid: Routing change seems fastest to restore provisioning while we fix nodes.
devon: I'll open a routing rule rollback PR. @sre-bot can you run a quick canary to send new attach traffic away from eu-west2 for 10m?
sre-bot: Running route override: set prefer-region=global with weight eu-west2=0 -> success (eta: 45s) :hourglass:
sam: Nice. For the node fix, we should push v2.4.2 that adds a compactor-leader-lock and retries for extent-ref validation.
alex: Do we have a patch ready?
maria: Patch branch created: ops/compactor-lock-2026. Adding lockfile on ledger start, and guard that aborts second compaction if lock present. Unit tests added.
ingrid: QA plan?
devon: 1) smoke on a small eu-west2 canary 2) simulate heartbeat restart and ensure compaction doesn't run twice 3) verify attach path recovers on repaired host
sam: Cost/impact note: routing away from eu-west2 will add latency for some customers and cross-region egress. Estimated incremental cost ~€0.18/hr for heavy batch jobs.
alex: Ok let's do routing override now, then deploy v2.4.2 to canary, verify, then k-roll remainder.
maria: I'll cut the release and push artifacts. tagging v2.4.2
sre-bot: Artifact upload completed. Image digest: sha256:3b9f... Ready for rollout.
devon: Can we automate detection for double compaction in the future? add metric compaction_double_starts{ledger=} -> alert.
ingrid: +1. Also add watchdog that aborts compactor if it sees another compactor started within 500ms on same ledger.
alex: Who owns rollout plan?
maria: I'll coordinate with release-engineering. Target: canary 5 nodes in eu-west2 now, full roll after 30m if green.
sam: Keep me posted. I'll monitor GPU attach backlog and cost dashboards.
devon: Routing override in effect. Pending attach count dropping already from 2.8k -> 1200.
alex: Great. After full roll we should run a metadata-consistency check across nodes and surface any orphaned extents.
maria: Agreed. I'll create a follow-up ticket after release.
devon: Thanks team :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Incident note saved: id INC-20260323-janitor-compaction. Postmortem assigned to devon/maria.
